skill.name: inbox-placement-monitor
skill.description: Analyzes post-send seed-list placement, Gmail Postmaster exports, and Microsoft SNDS exports to track inbox, spam, promotions, and sender reputation by provider. Compares each send with a prior baseline and produces a reusable SEND-S placement snapshot.
skill.summary: Track post-send inbox placement, sender reputation, and provider regressions from exported telemetry.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, code fences, repository links, and homepage metadata. Two findings are confirmed: the live seed-send command can transmit email, and the dynamic save filename lacks a required path-normalization rule. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious reconnaissance intent was found.

remediation.issue: The save filename uses an unsanitized domain-or-topic placeholder.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize the filename to a strict allowlist and reject separators, parent-directory segments, absolute paths, and empty values before writing.

remediation.issue: The documented seed-send command includes the consequential --live flag.
remediation.suggestion: Keep dry-run as the default and require immediate approval after displaying sender, recipients, subject, message count, and selected account.

content.user_title: Monitor Inbox Placement and Sender Reputation
content.value_statement: Email teams often lack a clear view of where messages land after each campaign. This skill compares exported placement and reputation data across providers and sends.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes seed-list results for Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, and Apple across inbox, spam, promotions, and other folders.
Reads Gmail Postmaster domain reputation, IP reputation, spam-rate trends, feedback-loop signals, and delivery errors.
Reads Microsoft SNDS IP status, complaint rates, spam-trap hits, and available volume trends.
Compares the current send with a prior baseline and names each regression with its measured magnitude.
Labels metrics as Measured, User-provided, or Estimated and marks missing providers as NEEDS_INPUT.
Produces a reusable SEND-S placement snapshot for downstream deliverability and email quality reviews.
limitations: Requires user-provided exports and seed-test observations; it does not access provider accounts automatically.
Cannot determine actual folder placement without observations from the tested seed inboxes.
Does not perform SPF, DKIM, or DMARC preflight checks and does not calculate the full email quality score.
Optional Resend automation depends on an available helper, and every live send requires explicit approval.

use_cases.title: Diagnose campaign placement
use_cases.description: Compare a recent campaign across mailbox providers and identify where inbox, spam, or promotions placement changed.

use_cases.title: Trend sender reputation
use_cases.description: Review Gmail Postmaster and Microsoft SNDS exports across sends to identify domain or IP reputation declines.

use_cases.title: Report client regressions
use_cases.description: Create a provider-level placement summary with measured deltas, missing inputs, and recommended follow-up work.

prompt_templates.title: Review one send
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this seed-list placement test for [domain]. Report inbox, spam, and promotions by provider. Mark missing providers as NEEDS_INPUT.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a clear placement summary for one campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Trend reputation signals
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Gmail Postmaster and Microsoft SNDS exports for [domain]. Describe each reputation signal, direction, and measured concern.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs a focused domain and IP reputation review.

prompt_templates.title: Compare campaign baselines
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the current placement test with the prior send. Name every provider regression, calculate its magnitude, and identify stable signals.
prompt_templates.scenario: An experienced marketer needs a send-over-send performance comparison.

prompt_templates.title: Build an advanced handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a SEND-S placement snapshot for [goal]. Include provider placement, Postmaster and SNDS trends, complaint thresholds, data labels, gaps, and routing recommendations.
prompt_templates.scenario: A deliverability specialist needs a structured handoff for a broader quality gate.

output_examples.input: Seed test: Gmail 88% inbox and 12% promotions; Outlook 70% inbox and 30% junk; Yahoo and Apple missing.
output: Gmail: 88% inbox and 12% promotions. Promotions placement is a measured concern.
Outlook: 70% inbox and 30% junk. This is the largest measured placement concern.
Yahoo and Apple: NEEDS_INPUT because no seed results were provided.

output_examples.input: Gmail domain reputation changed from High to Medium, while spam rate increased from 0.08% to 0.14%.
output: Gmail domain reputation declined from High to Medium.
Spam rate increased by 0.06 percentage points and crossed the 0.1% red line.
Placement is degrading. Review the sending change and route reputation setup issues to deliverability QA.

output_examples.input: Current Yahoo inbox placement is 71%. The prior send recorded 96%. Other providers are unchanged.
output: Yahoo inbox placement declined by 25 percentage points, from 96% to 71%.
No regression was reported for the other measured providers.
Record Yahoo as the named regression and preserve this run as the next baseline.

best_practices: Export placement and reputation data from the same campaign period before comparing providers.
Provide a prior baseline whenever possible and label every source as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
Review sender, recipients, subject, and message count before approving any live seed send.
anti_patterns: Do not infer a passing result for mailbox providers that are missing from the seed test.
Do not paste account credentials, API keys, or session tokens into placement data.
Do not run the live seed-send command without reviewing the full recipient list and message details.

faq.question: Does this skill send email?
faq.answer: Analysis uses exported data. The optional Resend helper can send seed messages only after explicit approval.

faq.question: Does it connect to Gmail Postmaster or Microsoft SNDS?
faq.answer: No. Provide exports or pasted results from accounts you control.

faq.question: Which mailbox providers can it compare?
faq.answer: The workflow covers Gmail, Outlook or Microsoft, Yahoo, and Apple or iCloud when seed results are available.

faq.question: Does it replace authentication checks?
faq.answer: No. Use a deliverability preflight workflow for SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and related setup checks.

faq.question: What happens when there is no prior baseline?
faq.answer: The skill states that no delta is available and records the current run as the next baseline.

faq.question: How are missing provider results handled?
faq.answer: Each missing provider is marked NEEDS_INPUT. The skill does not assume a passing result.
